name: Cooler Walks
androidShortDescription: Find city walks with greenery, waterside paths and estimated building shade.
description:
Choose a different way through the city. Cooler Walks compares real walking routes within your extra-time limit, with greenery and nearby water as separate preferences.

Plan with a start, destination and up to three waypoints. Choose your departure time, allow zero, five or ten extra minutes, and compare the alternatives evaluated. In supported areas, prefer estimated shade or sun. In Zurich, prefer calmer streets using official traffic-calming zones and mapped main-road proximity, within the same detour limit. This is street context, not live traffic or noise measurement. Switch between English and German without losing your trip. Download available areas for planning offline. No account is required.

PILOT COVERAGE
Zurich and Munich: selected central areas with experimental building-shade estimates.
Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA: municipal-boundary routing with greenery and water proximity.
Basel: a central pilot with greenery and water proximity.
The coverage boundary is visible in the planner. These are bounded pilots, not blanket citywide or worldwide services.

ABOUT THE ESTIMATES
Shade is a geometric estimate of direct sunlight blocked by buildings at the selected departure time. It does not model tree shadows, clouds or terrain shadows. Greenery and water proximity do not establish shade, access or a measured temperature benefit. Walking conditions, access restrictions and closures can differ on the ground. This is a route planner, not live turn-by-turn navigation or an accessibility assessment.

PRIVACY
Search and routing use downloaded data on your device. Location is optional and requested only when you choose it. Precise journey history is not saved. Website and map downloads contact the hosting provider. See the privacy notice for details.
reviewNotes: No login or subscription. Select Zurich and use the example journey in the planner. Choose 21 June 2026 at 14:00 Europe/Zurich and allow 5 extra minutes to compare building shade where model coverage is sufficient. Switch Prefer shade / Prefer sun; move the departure time to compare modelled exposure. Cambridge and Basel are intentionally greenery-only. The full native build includes all four larger pilot areas; the smaller Munich Old Town area can be downloaded from the configured HTTPS host. Offline packs contain public data, never executable code. Location permission is optional. Physical-device and final hosted-download tests must be completed before submission. Version 0.6.0/build 4 supports German and a Zurich-only calmer-street preference. EN/DE preserves the trip; the calmer reference route from Bahnhofquai to Bürkliplatz takes about three extra minutes and reduces mapped main-road proximity. It also includes historical 2025 directional vehicle-count evidence near Zurich routes. Counts remain separate from street-context ranking and are not live traffic or a forecast.
